# forgo: _test.fgo files are test files, and external test files when
# they declare the _test package, rather than ordinary package sources.

sleep 2s # The module index ignores packages with files newer than 2 seconds.

go list -f '{{.GoFiles}} {{.TestGoFiles}} {{.XTestGoFiles}}' m/p
stdout '^\[p.fgo\] \[p_test.fgo\] \[p_x_test.fgo\]$'

go list -test -deps -f '{{.ImportPath}}' m/p
stdout '^m/p_test \[m/p.test\]$'

[short] skip 'runs go test'

go test -v m/p
stdout '^--- PASS: TestInternal'
stdout '^--- PASS: TestExternal'
stdout '^ok'
! stdout 'no test files'

# Coverage instruments p.fgo but not the test files.
go test -cover m/p
stdout 'coverage: 100.0% of statements'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.27
-- p/p.fgo --
package p

import "strconv"

func Double(s string) (n int, err error) {
	n = strconv.Atoi(s)?
	return 2 * n, nil
}
-- p/p_test.fgo --
package p

import "testing"

func TestInternal(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := Double("x")
	t.Fatal("no error for x") if err == nil
}
-- p/p_x_test.fgo --
package p_test

import (
	"testing"

	"m/p"
)

func TestExternal(t *testing.T) {
	n, err := p.Double("21")
	t.Fatalf("Double(21) = %d, %v", n, err) if n != 42 || err != nil
}
